title: Use Internal Logs, Metrics, and Audit Evidence
objectives: Use Internal Logs, Metrics, and Audit Evidence
Demonstrate actual outcomes and independently inspect evidence.

tasks.instruction: Create a canonical report titled Evidence report on sh01, app search, owner admin, sharing App. Use index=ops_logs | stats count, a -15m to now window, and UTC cron * * * * *.

Advance to one scheduled dispatch and inspect its actual receipt. Search index=_internal source=*scheduler.log savedsearch_name="Evidence report" status=success | stats count, open Job Inspector, and confirm one native log row corresponds to the real run. Compare recorded service observations and configuration provenance; generated metrics alone do not prove this report ran.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.
